newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Highlands in farm out to Inco.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands in farm out to Inco.

text.p: Highlands Gold Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to farm out up to 60 percent of two of its exploration areas in Indonesia to Canada's Inco Ltd who will fund exploration expenditures of US$10 million.
The two contract of work areas cover an area of over 6,000 square kilometres and are located in the Aceh province of Northern Sumatra.
Highlands said the focus of recent exploration was at the Miwah gold prospect which has located 17 anomalies and the Beutong porphry copper prospect.
"Highlands welcomes the involvement of a major company of Inco's standing in this exciting project," Highlands managing director Ian Goddard said in a statement.
Inco has a pre-existing and seperate agreement with junior Canadian explorer, Colony Pacific Explorations Ltd, for exploration in Sumatra.

Under this agreement Colony can earn an interest in the project and should Inco and Colony earn their maximum interest, final holdings will be Inco, 36 percent, Highlands 30 percent, Colony 24 percent and Indonesian partner 10 percent.

Higlands is currently the subject of a 75 cents a share takeover bid from Canada's Placer Dome Inc, a bid which Highlands has described as inadequate and undervalued the company's long-term potential.
At 10.45 a.m. (2345 GMT), Highlands shares were one cent weaker at 75 cents.
